Hi Elena — great to hear from you and congrats on the turnout so far. Short answer: yes, we can do 500 single-use codes. A couple quick clarifying points so I can route this for sign-off: 

- Redemption mechanics: we can provide single-use codes (CSV of codes) or send unique redemption links. Links are slightly easier for us to track and audit; codes are simple to hand out. Which do you prefer?
- Trial length: we typically offer a 30-day extension; we can make that 45 days for strategic partners but need approvals for anything over 30 days.
- Expiry and blackout windows: confirm you want expiry = 30 days after issue (that works).
- Reporting: we will provide a CSV with redemption results + basic activation metrics 7 days post-event.

If you prefer codes, please confirm whether attendees will receive codes only (one per person) or whether you need bulk codes for distribution by cohorts. Also let me know if procurement requires an invoice. I'll loop Laura to confirm the budget/ops and Marcus for final allocation.

Thanks — I can get this into the pipeline today once you confirm code vs link and trial length.

Best,
